description.value:
Requirement You are wielding two firearms.

Duration constant

There has not been a first shot and a second shot in a very long time.

Every action you take that makes a ranged Strike makes one with each firearm, at no additional cost and with no multiple attack penalty between them. Both weapons are emptied as normal, and Never Both Empty or Legendary Reload, if you have either, keeps this sustainable.

cinderfall.incomplete: same "recomposes the Strike action itself" problem as both-of-them-at-once/two-hands-one-verdict's own kin above. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP.
